(3) Test tightening: scope the rebase/forbidden-op assertion to the post-merge section, assert ff-from-tracking-ref, and cover fresh-trigger. Also plugin ship should emit the exact POST_MERGE_SYNC_BLOCKED token, not bare 'BLOCKED'. All items fail closed / are non-data-loss.
